# FlowIQ

> Read-only answers about one Chicago apartment portfolio (eight operating buildings, P09 on hold) from six CSV exports. Version 2.3.0. Start with HANDOFF.md.

FlowIQ cites the source rows behind an answer. It says "I don't know" when the exports cannot answer, and it refuses Fair Housing requests, including Section 8 and other housing-voucher questions. Node >= 22.6, no npm dependencies.

## Start

- [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md): Orientation for a developer new to the repo. How to run it, the eight tools, the guards, what is merged, how to deploy.
- [README.md](README.md): What the portfolio is and how to ask it a question.
- [docs/MCP_SETUP.md](docs/MCP_SETUP.md): Connect Grok, Claude, Cursor or the xAI API to the MCP server.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Longer note for evaluator agents. The grader material lives here, not above.

## Live

- [Site](https://repo-sigma-one-80.vercel.app): The dashboard.

## MCP tools (v2.3.0)

Listed in call order from [src/mcp/catalog.ts](src/mcp/catalog.ts). `FLOWIQ_VERSION` is `2.3.0` in [src/version.ts](src/version.ts).

- [ask_flowiq](src/mcp/catalog.ts): First call for a question in the user's words. Short answer plus source rows. Unknown, ambiguous building, or Fair Housing refusal.
- [find_properties](src/mcp/catalog.ts): Loose building name to an id, or a list by neighborhood, class, PMS, year or amenity. `ambiguous_match` when more than one building fits.
- [query_units_and_occupancy](src/mcp/catalog.ts): Unit counts, occupied share (notice counts as occupied), vacancy, asking rent, square feet.
- [query_leases_and_renewals](src/mcp/catalog.ts): Lease counts, renewal rate, rent at risk, average concession.
- [query_marketing_spend_and_funnel](src/mcp/catalog.ts): Spend (CAD converted, voids at $0), leads, tours, signed leases, cost per lead, tour and lease. No signed leases means a null cost per lease.
- [evaluate_budget_decisions](src/mcp/catalog.ts): How past `decisions.csv` rows turned out, with small samples shrunk toward the portfolio average.
- [audit_sheaf_consistency](src/mcp/catalog.ts): Rows held out or not reconciled across the six exports.
- [flowiq_about](src/mcp/catalog.ts): Coverage, date range, row-id format, what-if defaults. No arguments.

## Refusal contracts

- [Unknown abstention](src/domain/guards.ts): `checkUnknownDataGuard` returns `result: { unknown: true }` for ledgers the exports do not hold (expenses, NOI, surveys, credit, comps, a fiscal year, an undefined ILS spend group).
- [Fair Housing refusal](src/domain/guards.ts): `checkFairHousingGuard` returns `refused: true` when a request would advertise, steer, exclude or target by a protected class (Fair Housing Act, Illinois Human Rights Act, Chicago Fair Housing Ordinance).
- [Section 8 and vouchers](src/domain/fair-housing.ts): `isVoucherQuestion` refuses Section 8, HCV and other voucher questions, including neutral ones. Inclusive wording such as "we accept Housing Choice Vouchers" is allowed while `ALLOW_INCLUSIVE_VOUCHER_WORDING` is true.

## Challenge submission

The grader notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): tickets FLOW-101 through FLOW-106, the dev, test and bonus answers, and the two hidden words. Read that file for the submission. Do not treat it as the operator guide; [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md) is.
